'''blown away Out Deploy,Out Last''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[blown away]]
* '''Published:''' 26 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|The Signal|JP-L-thesignal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HB away LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the first deck I've ever submitted, and to be honest I've never really played outside of a circle of a few friends and I don't use virtual cards...yet.  I have no idea how this deck would do in a tournament, so any advice would be greatly appreciated.

== Notes ==

* No starting section; the strategy starts The Signal (to pull Haven onto Rendezvous Point) with the Hidden Base objective.
* Tatooine x2 is a unique system; dested as posted.
* Posted Courlag dested Corulag; B-wing dested B-wing Attack Fighter; X-wing x2 dested the Premiere X-wing; Special Modification dested Special Modifications; R3-A2 dested R3-A2 (Arthree-Aytoo).
* The author says he uses no virtual cards; every card is a Decipher printing.

== Strategy ==

My strategy is fairly simple.  I use The Signal as a starting interrupt and bring out Haven on Rendezvous point.  I do this so I can quickly deploy large amounts of starships and pilots.  This way when I flip Hidden Base, usually in 4 or 5 turns, it is very difficult for my opponent to keep up in space.  I also put mercenary armor and undercover on Leia RP to help cancel a couple force drains if I can’t do so with Rebel Fleet or the objective card.

I'm really curious to see if this deck is remotely tournament caliber.  Opinions and advice would be great! Thanks.
